attributes.board_name: Wyoming State Board of Examiners of Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology

rules.accepted_credit_types: CEU directly related to the scope of practice, sponsored by national, regional or state professional associations such as AAA, ABA, ASHA or the Wyoming Speech-Language-Hearing Association. Ways to earn: college courses (1 semester credit = 15 CEU, 1 quarter credit = 10 CEU), online courses, lectures/workshops/seminars, journals offered for CEU, presenting (max 3 CEU), refereed articles (max 3 CEU), clinical supervision of SLPA/SLP/audiology students (1 CEU per 30 hours, max 6 CEU). A course repeated in the same period counts once.
rules.new_licensee_rule: The initial license expires Dec 31 of the year after the year of issue.
rules.audit_note: Each year 10% of current licensees are randomly selected by Feb 15 after renewal to submit proof of CEU; disallowed CEU must be cured within 30 days.
rules.legal_basis: Wyoming Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology Board Rules, Ch. 2 §§7–8; W.S. 33-33-306
rules.notes: Unit is the Board's CEU: 1 contact hour = 1 CEU (not ASHA's 10-hour CEU), so 10 CEU = 10 contact hours per year. CEU must be earned Jan 1 – Dec 31 of the expiration year; licenses expire every Dec 31 (renewal must be postmarked by Dec 31, no grace period per the Board's renewal page). The 2023 rule package cut the requirement from 12 to 10 CEU per year and replaced document submission with attestation plus audit. No later amendment was found, but the Board's own rules page did not list the current rule text.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Same CEU criteria as licensees (Chapter 2 CEU requirements).

topics.who: Supervising SLPs (not the assistant): at least 2 hours of CE in supervision before supervising an SLPA; counts toward the SLP's renewal CEU

rules.legal_basis: Wyoming Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology Board Rules, Ch. 12 §5
rules.notes: SLP assistants hold an annual certificate expiring Dec 31 (initial certificate: Dec 31 of the year after issue); renewal requires attestation of 10 CEU (1 contact hour = 1 CEU) plus documentation of supervision. Assistants certified through experience renew under separate conditions (max 4 renewals).
